ResourceHeader.Description: Operational Level 1A image data from the Compact Coronagraph-2 (CCOR-2) aboard the SOLAR-1 spacecraft. The data consist of processed white-light coronagraph images of the solar corona. The images have dimensions of 2048 by 1920 pixels and are provided in FITS format in units of mean solar brightness (MSB). Level 1A products are generated from Level 0B data at an approximately 15-minute cadence for near-real-time space weather operations.

Parameter.Name: FITS Extension #1 White-Light Coronal Intensity Data Array
Parameter.Description: CCOR-2 Level 1A white-light coronal intensity stored in FITS extension #1 as a 2048 x 1920 pixel compressed floating-point image array. The image is expressed in mean solar brightness (MSB) and uses helioprojective solar coordinates with a zenithal polynomial (ZPN) projection. The plate scale is approximately 24.27 arcsec per pixel at the reference point. The CCOR-2 bandpass is approximately 469 to 755 nm. The reference time is specified by the DATE-OBS FITS keyword.
